description: This file defines a Console command class 'Generate' for generating documentation using the Daux static site generator, providing command-line options and execution logic for generating documentation in various formats.

classes.name: Generate
classes.description: A command class extending DauxCommand, used to generate documentation via CLI with configurable options.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command name, description, and CLI options such as format, delete, printDiffAndExit, and destination.

methods.name: prepareConfig
methods.description: Prepares and configures the build process based on input options, setting format and Confluence-specific flags.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the command, initializes input parameters, builds the documentation tree, and generates all documentation.
